### appHotkeys?

```ts
optional appHotkeys?: Readonly<Record<string, AppHotkey<string, HotkeyChord | HotkeySequence | null>>>;
```

Defined in: [packages/svelte-hotkeys/src/HotkeysCtx.ts:53](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/svelte-hotkeys/src/HotkeysCtx.ts#L53)

Every app hotkey, from `defineAppHotkeys`. Listed by `getAppHotkeyList`
whether or not they are registered. It can start as `undefined` and arrive
later, such as from a lazy import.

***

### customHotkeys?

```ts
optional customHotkeys?: 
  | CustomHotkeys<Readonly<Record<string, AppHotkey<string, HotkeyChord | HotkeySequence | null>>>>
  | null;
```

Defined in: [packages/svelte-hotkeys/src/HotkeysCtx.ts:60](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/svelte-hotkeys/src/HotkeysCtx.ts#L60)

The user's saved custom hotkeys. When the value changes, such as after
saved data loads or the user signs in, it replaces the current custom
hotkeys. `undefined` leaves them unchanged; `null` clears them. Unknown
ids and invalid entries are ignored.

***
